summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration test of the CCDP static marketing homepage. All main sections, testids, cards, nav smooth-scroll, counters, images and newsletter success flow work correctly on desktop and mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid-email toast does not appear because <input type=email required> triggers native HTML5 validation before the JS regex runs. Any value without '@' (e.g., 'notanemail') is blocked by the browser; values with '@' but bad format (e.g. 'invalid@') also fail to trigger the sonner error toast in tests. Consider using type='text' + JS validation, or noValidate on the form so the custom toast can fire.

integration_issues.issue: Review request expected data-testid='mobile-nav-link-*' but implementation uses 'mobile-nav-*' (e.g., mobile-nav-about, mobile-nav-programs). 9 mobile links render and are clickable, but naming diverges from spec. Align naming for consistency.

issues: Console a11y warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle/Description inside SheetContent for a11y.

action_items: Fix newsletter invalid-email path: add noValidate to the form or switch input type so the custom toast.error is reachable.
Rename mobile menu testids to 'mobile-nav-link-*' to match the review spec (or update spec).
Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle/Description to SheetContent to remove Radix a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer email regex is fine but unreachable due to native HTML5 validation on type=email required.
Sheet (Radix Dialog) needs an accessible title — add <SheetTitle> or VisuallyHidden.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home at / renders correctly. Verified: hero H1 'Creating the Future of Creative Careers.', hero-apply-btn, hero-partner-btn, all 6 nav-link-* smooth scroll to their sections, all 9 sections (mission/programs/curriculum/technology/impact/community/partners/news/apply) present, 12 program-card-*, 8 ecosystem-card-*, 3 news-card-*, stat-0..3 counters animate to real values (12+, 9, 150+, 92%), 0 broken images. Newsletter valid email shows success toast 'You're on the list. Welcome to CCDP.' and clears input. Mobile menu opens with 9 mobile-nav-* links plus mobile-apply-btn. Only issues: invalid-email toast unreachable due to HTML5 validation, mobile testid naming mismatch vs spec (mobile-nav-* vs mobile-nav-link-*), and Radix Sheet a11y warnings.
